youtube.title: Why Chillies Burn You But Not Birds (It's a Trick)
youtube.description: Why can a tiny bird swallow a chilli that makes you cry? Because the burn is not heat at all. Capsaicin tricks the heat-alarm nerve TRPV1 into shouting 'fire' while nothing is burning. The wild chilli evolved this to keep out mice, which crush its seeds, while birds, whose TRPV1 ignores capsaicin, carry the seeds far away. The burn was never meant for you. The Hidden Why explains the secret reason behind things you use every day. #TheHiddenWhy #facts #explained
